title: Step 1 — A lane and a stage

props.covers: Step 1 of the worked example: a skeleton batch establishes Config and Stage, then separate section-fill batches add the Config pills and Stage sticky while each pushed render is reviewed.

text.insert: Step 1 — A lane and a stage

The agent studies the boot digest, full-board render, house exemplar, and vocabulary sheet, then sends the complete section skeleton: Config at the left and Stage at the right. After judging that pushed render, it fills Config in one batch with three same-role rectangles that copy one size and one repeated gap, judges the Config close-up, and only then fills Stage with its sticky. The coordinates use 16px grid units as quantization; content and peer relationships determine the geometry. Each payload below is one apply_ops call, validated atomically. A rejected call changes nothing and returns only rejection lines. Every successful call returns APPLIED, a fresh BOARD digest, DELTA, cumulative BOARD DIFF, diagnostic state, and REQUESTS; the first apply prints the full DIAGNOSTICS list and later calls print LINTS deltas. Document changes push a fresh full-board render, and view adds the requested close-up. No connection is touched, so ROUTES is absent. Any crowding warning on the compact vertical stack marks a physical corridor floor that the agent must open or name explicitly at finalize.
